units.source_text: 還有，到別人家做客時，主人端上來的飯菜，就算我不喜歡也會忍著吃下。

en.t: Also, when I was a guest at someone else's house, I would force myself to eat the food they served, even if I did not like it.

units.source_text: 對於小時候的我而言，最為痛苦的時刻莫過於在自己家吃飯。

en.t: For me as a child, the most painful moments of all were mealtimes at my own home.

units.source_text: 在鄉下的家裡，每次用餐時，全家十幾口人圍著餐桌迎面而坐，

en.t: At our house in the country, every time we ate, the whole family of more than ten people sat facing one another around the dining table,

units.source_text: 飯菜擺成兩列，我身為家中老小，坐在最靠邊的末座。

en.t: with the dishes arranged in two rows, and as the youngest child I sat at the very end, in the lowest place.

units.source_text: 用餐的房間燈光昏暗，午餐時，全家十幾口人一聲不吭吃飯的光景，讓我不寒而慄。

en.t: The room where we ate was dim, and at lunch the sight of more than ten family members eating in complete silence made me shudder.

units.source_text: 加之我家又是一個古板守舊的鄉下大家庭，每頓飯菜幾乎一成不變，

en.t: On top of that, ours was a stiff, old-fashioned rural household, and the food was almost exactly the same at every meal,

units.source_text: 別指望會有什麼山珍海味和奢侈大餐，久而久之，使我對用餐時間充滿恐懼。

en.t: so there was no hope of rare delicacies or lavish feasts, and before long mealtime filled me with fear.
